desk.headline: Q3 profit up 13% to ₩1.91tn (reported 29 Oct); KB Securities hit with ₩332bn bond-auction fine; no guidance

other.label: Net profit attributable to shareholders, Q3
Net profit attributable to shareholders, 9 months

results: KB's Q3 results came out on 29 October; the 13 November filing is not a results release.
Preliminary Q3 net profit rose 13% to ₩1.91tn from ₩1.69tn; nine-month profit rose 13% to ₩5.79tn. Figures are still under audit review.
Press coverage said Q3 profit slipped from Q2's record as stock trading cooled and brokerage fees fell.
On 11 November the Korea Fair Trade Commission fined KB Securities ₩332.2bn over alleged collusion among primary dealers in government bond auctions.
KB Securities will review the formal decision when it arrives; the final amount may differ from the regulator's press release.

guidance.summary: KB gives no earnings guidance in these filings.

watch: The regulator's written decision and KB Securities' response, including any appeal.

Audited Q3 figures, as the reported numbers are preliminary.

results: These are the auditor-reviewed Q3 accounts (review dated 16 Nov); the first results release came on 29 October.
Q3 profit to shareholders was ₩1.76tn, up 4.3% from ₩1.69tn, and about ₩149bn below the ₩1.91tn preliminary figure; the nine-month total is also ₩149bn lower at ₩5.64tn.
Net interest income rose 5% to ₩3.51tn and net fees rose 14% to ₩1.13tn, but credit provisions jumped 55% to ₩563bn and pre-tax profit slipped 3%.
Diluted EPS was ₩4,851, up 9% thanks to fewer shares after buybacks; in nine months KB bought back ₩1.68tn of shares and cancelled ₩2.53tn.
Total assets reached ₩851tn and shareholders' equity ₩60.7tn at 30 September.

guidance.summary: KB gives no earnings guidance. On the 29 Oct call management expected full-year credit costs in the mid-40 basis-point range.

points: Margins slipped 2bp in Q3 (group NIM 1.92%) on deposit outflows; management expects loan yields to improve in Q4 after this year's rate hikes.
Higher Q3 provisions were described as a cautious stance as rates rise; management flagged possible weaker asset quality.
Quarterly fee income fell sharply from Q2 as stock trading cooled; about ₩1tn a quarter is seen as the base level.
CET1 capital ratio was 13.80%; the ₩700bn buyback is complete and the Q3 dividend is ₩1,167 a share.
Shareholder returns for 2027 will depend on the year-end CET1 ratio; no new policy is final yet.
